These verses express the purpose of God to administer a just government, and in a time of anarchy that He sustains the nation. Some apply the words to the Psalmist.<div eID="gen9723" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen9724" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">receive the congregation--</hi>literally, "take a set time" (<reference osisRef="Ps.102.13">Psa 102:13</reference>; <reference osisRef="Hos.2.3">Ho 2:3</reference>), or an assembly at a set time--that is, for judging. <div eID="gen9724" type="x-p"/>
